- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.6) — model tends to overshoot early in upward trends.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.4) — model fails to capture sharp downside reversals.
- Lag in price spikes: model often peaks 1–2 days after true price surge, especially when sentiment rises sharply.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after strong moves, underestimating continuation of trend.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate later periods (e.g., 15–30 days) when sentiment is volatile or uncertain.
- Avoid “flat” forecast when sentiment is trending — model underreacts to sentiment shifts, especially when sentiment drops below 0.5.
